ai_review.summary: Remastered recording praised for incredible clarity and instrument separation, with enthusiastic fan appreciation
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gave the release five stars, highlighting a spectacular remaster that brings out every instrument and vocal with unprecedented detail. The first review especially lauds the improved sonic separation and overall brilliance of the new mix, while no specific musical performance details are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are five‑star and emphasize an outstanding remaster; however only two brief comments limit certainty about the live performance itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered version noted for dramatically improved clarity, instrument separation, and overall brilliance; described as a ‘recut jewel’ that reveals hidden details.
